"import cadquery as cq

# Define dimensions (mm)
# Horizontal Leg: X 0-100, Y 0-50, Z 0-12
h_len = 100.0
h_thick = 12.0
width = 50.0

# Vertical Leg: X 0-12, Y 0-50, Z 0-70
v_thick = 12.0
v_height = 70.0

# Fillet and Hole dimensions
fillet_radius = 10.0
hole_diameter = 10.0
hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2.0

# 1. Create the Horizontal Leg
# Center of box at (50, 25, 6) to span 0-100, 0-50, 0-12
h_leg = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(h_len, width, h_thick, centered=(True, True, True))
    .translate((50, 25, 6))
)

# 2. Create the Vertical Leg
# Center of box at (6, 25, 35) to span 0-12, 0-50, 0-70
v_leg = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(v_thick, width, v_height, centered=(True, True, True))
    .translate((6, 25, 35))
)

# 3. Union to form L-bracket
part = h_leg.union(v_leg)

# 4. Create Inner Concave Fillet
# The inner corner is at the intersection of the inner face of vertical leg (X=12)
# and the top face of horizontal leg (Z=12).
# This edge runs along Y.
# We select the edge nearest to a point on this intersection line, e.g., (12, 25, 12).
# Standard fillet on a re-entrant (270 deg) edge removes material, creating a concave fillet.
part = part.edges(cq.NearestToPointSelector((12, 25, 12))).fillet(fillet_radius)

# 5. Create Holes
# Horizontal Leg Hole: Axis parallel to Z, Centered at (56, 25).
# Leg Z range is 0-12, so hole center Z is 6.
# Axis is Z, so cylinder extrudes in Z direction.
h_hole_center = (56, 25, 6)
h_hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(hole_radius)
    .extrude(20)  # Height 20 > thickness 12
    .translate((h_hole_center[0], h_hole_center[1], h_hole_center[2] - 10))
)

# Vertical Leg Hole: Axis parallel to X, Centered at (25, 41).
# Leg X range is 0-12, so hole center X is 6.
# Axis is X, so we create on YZ plane and extrude in X.
v_hole_center = (6, 25, 41)
v_hole = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .circle(hole_radius)
    .extrude(20)  # Length 20 > thickness 12
    .translate((v_hole_center[0] - 10, v_hole_center[1], v_hole_center[2]))
)

# Cut holes from the part
part = part.cut(h_hole).cut(v_hole)

# 6. Export
cq.exporters.export(part, "part.step")"
